title: Fire damper actuation device.
officialText:
The fire damper actuation device shall meet one of the following requirements:
1. The operating temperature shall be approximately 50°F (28°C) above the normal temperature within the duct system,
but not less than 160°F (71°C).
2. The operating temperature shall be not more than 350°F (177°C) where located in a smoke control system complying
with Section 909 of the New York City Building Code.
